title: Memmy
excerpt: Memmy is a local-first AI agent with a self-evolving memory foundation, letting the desktop app, CLI and external agents share the same long-term context.
content_html:
Let every remember the same you

Memory that powers
preference understanding,
task relay, and continuous evolution.

Built for people who work with several AI tools every day.
What you said, decided and care about — Memmy keeps it organized.

Memmy

GPT-5.6 Luna2M tokens free trial

How it works

Three steps, from strangers to in sync

01

Scan

After you authorize it, Memmy scans the conversation history of AI tools on your device, like Cursor, Claude and Codex.

02

Organize

Distills scattered conversations into structured memory — your preferences, decisions, project background and pitfalls — deduplicated, categorized and searchable.

03

Inject

When you switch to any AI tool, Memmy hands it the most relevant memory — not a full data dump, but precise on-demand matching.

DATA SECURITY

Your memory belongs to you alone

01

All memory stays local

Every piece of memory data is stored on your own device and never uploaded to any remote server. Your computer is your memory vault.

02

Never collected without consent

Memmy never reads or processes any AI conversation history without your knowledge. Every scan requires your explicit authorization and can be revoked at any time.

03

You decide who can use it

You fully control which agent can use each memory and how much context is passed. You can view or delete any memory anytime, and turn off any source.

Let every AI remember the same you

它是如何运作的

三步，从陌生到同步

01

Scan

在您授权后，Memmy 会扫描您设备上的 AI 工具的对话历史记录，例如 Cursor、Claude 和 Codex。

02

组织

将分散的对话提炼成结构化记忆——您的偏好、决定、项目背景和陷阱——进行重复数据删除、分类和可搜索。

03

注入

当你切换到任何人工智能工具时，Memmy 都会为它提供最相关的内存——不是完整的数据转储，而是精确的按需匹配。

数据安全

你的记忆只属于你一个人

01

所有内存都保留在本地

每一条内存数据都存储在您自己的设备上，永远不会上传到任何远程服务器。 您的计算机就是您的存储库。

02

未经同意绝不采集

Memmy 绝不会在您不知情的情况下读取或处理任何 AI 对话历史记录。 每次扫描都需要您的明确授权，并且可以随时撤销。

03

您决定谁可以使用它

您完全控制哪个代理可以使用每个内存以及传递多少上下文。 您可以随时查看或删除任何内存，并关闭任何来源。

让每个AI记住同一个你
